# Security Audit Kit

> Toolkit otomatisasi security testing web/API (DAST + SCA), lintas sistem operasi dan
> berbasis konfigurasi, non-destruktif dengan rollback otomatis, dengan laporan
> berstandar konsultan IT security. Open-source (Apache-2.0), dibuat oleh hadymaggot.

Entry point: `python audit.py <modul>` (identik di Windows/Linux). Kredensial lewat
environment variable. Acuan: OWASP Top 10 2021, OWASP API Security Top 10 2023, ASVS.

## Modul
- access control / BOPLA (authz, mass-assignment), injection (SQLi), upload, auth-policy
- client-leak, cors, open-redirect, tls, headers, webstack (banner→CVE), deps (Trivy/semgrep/gitleaks), zap
- Uji destruktif (mis. mass-assignment) dipulihkan otomatis via rollback journal.
